title: The King's Hit List, Part 1
description: The King's Hit List, Part 1 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: You think that Sir Ving N'Seacressy asked you to take out the Guild of Shadows Recruit on Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. After taking the recruit down return to Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 2

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: You think that Sir Ving N'Seacressy asked you to take out the Guild of Shadows Recruit on Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. After taking the recruit down return to Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Say, you look like the type of Dungeon Runner that can see behind the shadowy veil and peer into the darkness that surrounds us all and threatens to take our very lives before our time. Or I guess you could just be gassy. Either way, you're here and I need your help, hypothetically speaking.

Let me run you through a possible scenario: The King's Board of Trustees has a partnership with the Guild of Shadows to take out high profile targets. Then, out of nowhere, the Guild of Shadows stops following through on the arranged hits. What is causing this disruption in service? What do you do, Dungeon Runner? What do you do?

Well, if I were you, I'd try to earn the trust of an established operative, such as myself. If you were to approach me and show interest in gaining my trust and helping to solve a completely hypothetical scenario, I'd probably send you into Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace and tell you to find and take out the promising Guild of Shadows Recruit that has been hanging around there. If you were to do that, then you could probably find me, Sir Ving N'Seacressy, possibly here in the Shadow's Gate.

Turn-in:

Good day to you stranger! Do you have the time?

*Sir Ving N'Seacressy looks around to make sure no one is listening in.*

Mission complete. Looks like you might have a future with us, Dungeon Runner. As we say in this business, by the time the owl hoots the dumpster is already awake. Take those words to heart, Dungeon Runner, they may just save your life.

Objectives:

  • Kill the Guild of Shadows Recruit
  • Collect the Proof of Pwnage ×1

Client level range: 45–100
